svg.title: The consolidation gate: one question at a time, each carrying its recommended answer, until a graph of nodes comes out
svg.desc: Before anything feature-sized is delegated, the request is interrogated until it is a spec. Feature-sized means two or more subagents doing actual work, more than roughly half an hour, or the operator saying some version of "from scratch". The mechanic is five steps: ask one question, not a list; carry your recommended answer with it; wait, then apply the answer; repeat until the next question has an obvious answer; emit a graph of nodes rather than a page of prose. What comes out is a set of imperative nodes, each with an owning agent, an instruction and a done-criterion that can be checked without redoing the work. When the operator is not there the gate does not stall and does not guess silently: each open question is written into the spec with its recommended answer marked as an assumption, everything reversible proceeds, and anything irreversible stops and is left as a human-reviewable item.
svg.text: BEFORE ANYTHING FEATURE-SIZED IS DELEGATED, THE REQUEST IS INTERROGATED UNTIL IT IS A SPEC
FEATURE-SIZED = TWO OR MORE SUBAGENTS · MORE THAN ROUGHLY HALF AN HOUR · "FROM SCRATCH"
A REQUEST ARRIVES
THE GATE — A MECHANIC, NOT AN ATTITUDE
01 · ASK ONE QUESTION. NOT A LIST. ONE.
02 · CARRY YOUR RECOMMENDED ANSWER WITH IT.
03 · WAIT FOR THE ANSWER. APPLY IT.
04 · REPEAT UNTIL THE NEXT ONE IS OBVIOUS.
05 · EMIT A GRAPH OF NODES, NOT PROSE.
"SHOULD THE EXPORT BE CSV OR JSON? I RECOMMEND JSON —
THE CONSUMER IS ANOTHER AGENT, NOT A HUMAN. AGREE?"
A LIST OF EIGHT QUESTIONS GETS SKIMMED, THEN ANSWERED
IN ONE LINE THAT ADDRESSES TWO OF THEM. ONE QUESTION
WITH A DEFAULT ATTACHED GETS EITHER A FAST YES OR THE
EXACT CORRECTION YOU WERE MISSING.
TEN CHEAP ROUND-TRIPS BEAT ONE EXPENSIVE MISUNDERSTANDING.
WHAT COMES OUT — IMPERATIVE NODES, NOT A PAGE OF PROSE
NODE-1 [DOCS-AGENT]
DRAFT THE API REFERENCE FOR THE /EXPORT ENDPOINT.
DONE WHEN: EVERY PUBLIC PARAMETER DOCUMENTED.
NODE-2 [REVIEW-AGENT]
REVIEW NODE-1 OUTPUT FOR FACTUAL DRIFT.
DONE WHEN: ZERO UNVERIFIED CLAIMS REMAIN.
NODE-3 [REVIEW-AGENT]
STANDING SECURITY PASS OVER THE DIFF.
DONE WHEN: NO FINDING ABOVE "INFORMATIONAL".
EACH NODE CARRIES AN OWNING AGENT, AN IMPERATIVE
INSTRUCTION, AND A DONE-CRITERION THAT CAN BE CHECKED
WITHOUT RE-DERIVING THE WORK.
WHEN THE OPERATOR IS NOT THERE — IT DOES NOT STALL, AND IT DOES NOT GUESS SILENTLY
WRITE THE QUESTION DOWN
WITH ITS RECOMMENDED ANSWER,
MARKED AS AN ASSUMPTION
PROCEED ON REVERSIBLE
ANYTHING A RE-RUN UNDOES
CARRIES ON AS NORMAL
STOP AT IRREVERSIBLE
LEAVE A HUMAN-REVIEWABLE
ITEM AND REPORT IT
IRREVERSIBLE HAS A PRECISE TEST: THE EFFECT CANNOT BE UNDONE BY RUNNING THE THING AGAIN.
